name: Rancho Cucamonga Fire Explorers
what_you_do: Train with firefighters in class and hands-on drills. Help with fire safety lessons and city events. Once you pass the training, you can ride along to watch real emergency calls.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 21. High school students need a 2.75 GPA with no grade below C. No serious arrests or convictions, and you must meet the grooming rules.
duration: Ongoing. Weekly Tuesday meetings, 7 to 10 pm, plus training academies and drills.
deadline_text: The program is full and takes no applications right now. Join the interest list on the page to hear when applications open.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Volunteer Interest List form on the Fire Youth Programs page. The district sends application news when spots open.
notes: The post started in 1997. The same page runs a week-long Junior Firefighter Camp for ages 11 to 15 each summer (28 spots per week). Registration opens at the end of April, and both 2026 camps filled. Meetings are at Jersey Fire Station 174, 11297 Jersey Blvd.
